Actually, I think the pattern is:

2. Charcoal spots appear in the NEXT cell to the RIGHT

5. Continue until... something

Actually, I already know from the first sequence that clicking (19, 24) as the 2nd click was correct (charcoal spots moved to a new position). Let me just follow that path: click (19, 24), then see where the charcoal spots move, and follow them.
